plan-the-application-description-names-i.text: Plan: the application description names its configuration.

approach.text: The fold library asks the application description, never an application by name. The description gains one pure question about an output: is this your configuration. Discovery asks it after the key-address check and before the request decoding; an output the description names as configuration is in neither the pending list nor the skipped list. The open datum description answers it with the same configuration decoding the booking reader already uses, so the two cannot disagree about what a configuration output is.

slice.text: One bisect-safe slice, one pull request, because the new field must be set wherever the description is built.

consumers-of-fold-discovery-that-the-gat.text: Consumers of fold discovery that the gate names at intake.

The conformance unit suite, the journey steps that fold late, the printed refusals of the open datum package, the refusal and observation scripts under tools/ for batch and termination refusals, the retained receipts that record skipped, and every page that describes the skip list.

model-position.text: Below: no change to what is folded, to any transition or to any on-chain script or hash. No wire format changes.
